tools.name: search_site_content
tools.description: Search this business site's own published pages (services, FAQ, about, contact) by keyword. Returns matching pages with title, URL, and a short excerpt. Use this for questions about services, pricing structure, policies, or anything specific to this business.

query.description: Keywords to search for in page titles, tags, and content

tools.name: search_griz_content
tools.description: Search griz.sh, this business owner's separate training blog, by keyword. Use this for general dog-training or dog-psychology questions that aren't specific to booking a session with this business - griz.sh has the deeper how-to and story content.

query.description: Keywords to search for in griz.sh's post titles, tags, and content

tools.name: search_custom_responses
tools.description: Search a small set of hand-written canned answers the business owner maintains directly, for questions that don't map cleanly onto a real page (e.g. current availability). Use this only after search_site_content doesn't turn up a clear answer.

query.description: Keywords to search for in the canned response titles and tags
